<h1>Hiring velocity</h1>
<p class="sub">Headcount change and revenue per employee from the live hiring-velocity feed. Click any column to sort ascending, click again to sort descending. Blank is missing, not zero.</p>
<input id="q" aria-label="Filter ticker or sector" placeholder="filter ticker / sector" autocomplete="off">
<div id="board" role="region" aria-label="Reported hiring rows" tabindex="0">Loading /data/hiring-velocity.json</div>
<details><summary>Complete received hiring packet, including other published subsets</summary><pre id="original" tabindex="0">Unavailable</pre></details>
<div class="foot"><b>Built for:</b> inspecting reported headcount changes and revenue per employee. Comparable source periods and forecasting value remain unverified.<br>
<b>Data:</b> /data/hiring-velocity.json (headcount latest, YoY, acceleration, revenue per employee, expansion score, inflection flag).<br>
<b>Sort:</b> header click toggles asc/desc. Nulls sort last.<br>
<b>Not:</b> Indeed/LinkedIn posting panels. Those tags are not in the feed.</div>
</div>
<script src="/jh-table-values.js"></script>
<script>
function esc(s){return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c];});}
function n(v,d){return JHTableValues.format(v,d==null?1:d);}
function cls(v){return JHTableValues.sign(v);}
function cmp(a,b,k,dir){
  if(k==="symbol")return JHTableValues.compare({symbol:a.symbol||a.ticker},{symbol:b.symbol||b.ticker},k,dir,"text");
  return JHTableValues.compare(a,b,k,dir,["name","sector","state"].includes(k)?"text":"number");
}
(async function(){
  var d=null, SORT="expansion_score", DIR=-1;
  try{var received=await JHTableValues.load("/data/hiring-velocity.json");d=received.packet;document.getElementById("original").textContent=received.raw;}catch(e){if(typeof e.original_text==='string')document.getElementById('original').textContent=e.original_text;document.getElementById("board").textContent=e.message;return;}
  var rows=(d&&(d.top_50||d.expansion_inflections))||[];
  if(!Array.isArray(rows)){document.getElementById("board").textContent="Published population is malformed; inspect the original packet.";return;}
  var malformed=rows.filter(function(x){return !x||typeof x!=="object"||Array.isArray(x);}).length;
  rows=rows.filter(function(x){return x&&typeof x==="object"&&!Array.isArray(x);});
  var cols=[["symbol","Ticker","l"],["name","Name","l"],["sector","Sector","l"],["headcount_latest","Headcount",""],["headcount_yoy_pct","HC YoY",""],["headcount_accel_pp","Accel pp",""],["revenue_per_employee","Rev/emp",""],["expansion_score","Score",""],["state","State","l"]];
  function paint(){
    var q=(document.getElementById("q").value||"").toUpperCase();
    var list=rows.filter(function(x){var t=String(x.symbol||x.ticker||"");return !q||t.toUpperCase().indexOf(q)>=0||String(x.sector||"").toUpperCase().indexOf(q)>=0;});
    list.sort(function(a,b){return cmp(a,b,SORT,DIR);});
    var h="<table><thead><tr>";
    cols.forEach(function(c){h+="<th class='"+(c[2]||"")+(SORT===c[0]?" on":"")+"' data-k="+c[0]+">"+c[1]+(SORT===c[0]?(DIR>0?" ↑":" ↓"):"")+"</th>";});
    h+="</tr></thead><tbody>";
    list.forEach(function(x){
      var t=x.symbol||x.ticker||"";
      h+="<tr><td class=l><a href=/ticker.html?symbol="+encodeURIComponent(t)+" style=color:#fff>"+esc(t)+"</a></td>";
      h+="<td class=l>"+esc(x.name||"")+"</td><td class=l>"+esc(x.sector||"")+"</td>";
      h+="<td>"+(JHTableValues.integer(x.headcount_latest)===null?"":JHTableValues.count(x.headcount_latest))+"</td>";
      h+="<td class="+cls(x.headcount_yoy_pct)+">"+JHTableValues.percent(x.headcount_yoy_pct,1)+"</td>";
      h+="<td class="+cls(x.headcount_accel_pp)+">"+n(x.headcount_accel_pp)+"</td>";
      h+="<td>"+(JHTableValues.number(x.revenue_per_employee)===null?"":"$"+n(x.revenue_per_employee,0))+"</td>";
      h+="<td>"+n(x.expansion_score)+"</td>";
      h+="<td class=l>"+esc((x.state||"")+(x.inflection===true?" · inflection":""))+"</td></tr>";
    });
    document.getElementById("board").innerHTML=h+"</tbody></table><p class=sub>"+list.length+" of "+rows.length+" rows in the received "+(Array.isArray(d.top_50)?"top_50":"expansion_inflections")+" subset; "+malformed+" malformed rows retained in the original packet. Publication "+esc(d.generated_at||"unavailable")+" does not establish observation freshness. Click headers or press Enter/Space to sort.</p>";
    JHTableValues.bindSort(document.querySelectorAll("#board th[data-k]"),SORT,DIR,function(k){if(SORT===k)DIR=-DIR;else{SORT=k;DIR=["symbol","name","sector","state"].includes(k)?1:-1;}paint();});
  }
  if(!rows.length){document.getElementById("board").textContent="Received subset has no displayable rows. Malformed rows: "+malformed+". Inspect the complete packet.";return;}
  document.getElementById("q").oninput=paint; paint();
})();
</script>
